---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea to enhance Simple Translator App
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when I can't save my translation history" or "It would be helpful if the app could..."

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include:
- Detailed explanation of the feature
- How it would improve the user experience
- Use cases where this feature would be valuable

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Implementation details (if applicable)
If you have any ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here:
- UI/UX suggestions
- Technical approach
- Related features or components

## User Impact
- **Users affected**: [e.g., All users, users translating certain language pairs, etc.]
- **Priority**: [Low, Medium, High, Critical]
- **Estimated difficulty**: [Easy, Medium, Hard]

## Additional context
Add any other context, mockups, wireframes, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Related issues
Link any related issues or discussions:
- Closes #
- Related to #
